def test_run_sft_shrinks_micro_batch_on_oom(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    torch.manual_seed(13)
    model = MythosMini(TINY)
    blocks = build_sft_blocks(["oom recovery sample text" * 4 for _ in range(8)], seq_len=64)
    config = SftConfig(epochs=1, micro_batch=8, learning_rate=1e-3, loops=2, seed=13)
    failures = {"left": 1}
    original = MythosMini.forward

    def flaky(self: MythosMini, tokens: torch.Tensor, loops: int | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        if tokens.shape[0] > 4 and failures["left"] > 0:
            failures["left"] -= 1
            raise torch.OutOfMemoryError
        return original(self, tokens, loops)

    monkeypatch.setattr(MythosMini, "forward", flaky)
    losses = run_sft(model, blocks, config, "cpu", torch.float32, tmp_path, base_step=0)
    assert len(losses) == 1
    assert losses[0] > 0.0
